thesis: PRE-MARKET (weekend) read on Saturday 2026-08-21's completed tape, planning the next trading day Monday 2026-08-24. Structure first: the multi-month frame is intact and, if anything, the near-term counterweights eased this run. SPY 765.72 keeps its deterministic 20>50>200 bull-stack (swing-structure-lab Bull-stacked, fast 762.33 over slow 707.54), +1.88% above its 50-day (~751.6) and +8.62% over its 200-day (~705.0), mom126/252 +11.66%/+21.33%, pctFrom52wHigh -1.56, so price sits about 1.6% under its highs rather than a break, though swing-structure-lab still qualifies a Double top pattern and reads its own trend regime as unknown. Breadth firmed further: market-heatmap-lab reads 58.1% of 134 (narrow but margin only -1.9, up from 29.99% on the 8/20 bar and 56.52% at Friday's close), so participation is pressing the 60% line. Counting persistence by distinct market-bar dates, the last three completed bars are 64.33% on 8/19, 29.99% on 8/20 and 58.1% on 8/21, so only one of the three cleared 60% and the latest sits just below the line; three-bar persistence above 60% is still not established. The dealer counterweight EASED but stayed negative: options-structure-lab / gamma-trading-lab (spot 765.72) read SPY still in negative dealer gamma, but signed net GEX lifted to -1.85B (from Friday's -2.84B) and the flip eased down to 768.79, so spot now sits about 3 points below the flip inside a tight 765/766 shelf (put wall 765, call wall 766) that only turns positive above ~768.79. The front expected move held at ±2.67 with atmIV 9.42%, in line with a VIX that reads a calm 15.13, and volatility-sizing-lab reads NORMAL (conditional vol 11.9395%, throttle x1.26). intraday-tape-lab reads Friday's session a Reversal risk auction under Algo-controlled control (VWAP 765.81, gap +0.45%, 79 bars). The near-term leaders are mixed: QQQ 713.44 is back exactly at its 50-day (~713.4, ma50Dist 0.01, mom5 -2.41) while SPMO 148.73 is -1.4% below its 50-day (~150.8) and holds +13.75% over its 200-day (~130.8). Flow stays constructive by premium: options-flow-feed-lab reads call-heavy/leaning-bullish (callFraction 0.7064, call premium $2.604B against put premium $1.082B across 12 tickers, 1800 contracts over the $250k bar) with the most-unusual print an AMD 470 CALL ($7.1M on 9.2x open interest, 0DTE), though a SPY 766 PUT and an NVDA 215 PUT sit next, a hint of index-level downside hedging at the shelf. Leadership tilts toward energy and defensives (XLE at its 52-week high with the highest sector rsMom 102.18, XLV and XLB Leading, XLU/XLP/XLRE/XLC Improving, XLF weakening, XLK Lagging), the global tape is Asia-led (EWS Singapore 88.5 vs ACWI) and real-asset leadership is crypto-led (ETH-USD 73.8, BTC 70.8, with GLD firming to 49.6). Structure first, tactical noise last: HOLD the intact structural SPY/SPMO core and the first beta-add tranche while breadth still sits under 60% for persistence, tilt the sector book toward the Leading energy/healthcare and Improving defensives funded from weakening financials, HOLD (not chase) MSFT, and carry only a SMALL weekend tail while dealers stay negative gamma with SPY under the 768.79 flip and the last session's character reads reversal-risk into a Monday open.
